question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

Nobody __should expect to become __successful without hard work.
solution:
The correct answer is **'​No substitution required.'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• There is no error in this sentence and the sentence is grammatically correct. (इस वाक्य में कोई त्रुटि नहीं है और वाक्य व्याकरणिक रूप से सही है।)
 
• Therefore, the correct option is '​No substitution required.'​
 
• Correct sentence: *Nobody should expect to become successful without hard work.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

 
• * *The meaning of* ***expect **is** to **regard (something) as likely to happen.

 
 
• **Example**:*It's as well to **expect** the worst.*
